name: Classify data type
description: Classify an incoming item by its primary work/domain type without deciding what action to take.
when_to_use: Use at intake before lifecycle routing. Prefer a durable domain object when clear; otherwise use the source/container type. Never invent a type.

existing_context.description: Known authoritative object identity or links

primary_data_type.instructions: Choose what the item itself primarily IS — its role — not the workflow step it implies or the action it asks for. An ask for work, attention, approval, or evaluation is a request, even when phrased as a question and even when vague. A checkpoint asking for assessment is a review_request; an approval interaction that is itself an ask is a request. Prefer a durable domain object when the context clearly establishes one; otherwise use a source/container type. Do not classify by topic. A container that holds evidence is still a note unless its role is to support a claim; a sign-off or validation record is verification, not a state note. Choose unclear_needs_review only when you cannot determine which type fits and the ambiguity would change routing — vagueness alone is not unclear. Choose other_needs_new when the item is meaningful but no active type fits. When two types are close, decide by the item's primary role, not secondary aspects.

criteria.request: A request for work or attention not already represented by a more specific governed object.
criteria.explore: An Explore artifact or exploration work object.
criteria.work_item: A discrete governed unit of execution work.
criteria.proposal: A proposed change or choice awaiting evaluation/approval.
criteria.evidence: Evidence supporting a claim, result, transition, or verification.
criteria.verification: A verification record or evidence package.
criteria.promotion_candidate: A candidate for promotion into a reusable/master standard.
criteria.risk: A risk that may block or materially affect work.
criteria.note: A general note not represented by a stronger domain object.
criteria.github_issue: A GitHub issue whose domain role is not yet more specifically known.
criteria.session: An agent/human interaction or execution session.
criteria.markdown_file: A Markdown file whose domain role is not yet known.
criteria.document: A general document whose domain role is not yet known.
criteria.incident: An operational failure or disruption requiring response - outage, data loss, security event, or similar. Distinct from quality_failure: the system or operation is broken, not merely its output.
criteria.quality_failure: A delivered work product that is broken, incomplete, or falsely claimed as complete/verified - the deliverable itself is defective. Distinct from incident (operational failure): the system works, the output doesn't.
criteria.other_needs_new: Meaningful item, but no active type fits.

changelog.reason: Phase 1B finding: incident corpus demonstrated a real missing type (other_needs_new used as fallback); 4/4 scored correct with incident candidate in Phase 1B suite vocabulary; promoted to canonical config per Ben split decision 2026-09-28 (incident = operational only)
Phase 1B finding: botched-deliverable cases had no home (golds stayed request); Ben decision 2026-09-28: split incident (operational only) vs quality_failure (deliverable quality)

Ben-approved Phase 1D 2026-09-28: instruction rewrite targeting boundary confusion (request vs review_request/open_question/risk/unclear, note vs evidence, verification vs state_note) and low-confidence calls
